content.title: Are Investors Overestimating AI's True Intelligence?
content.description: Investors riding the AI boom could be due for a reality check, Bloomberg Intelligence senior analyst Robert Lea says, with contemporary large language models unlikely to meet lofty expectations and "decidedly dumb." Lea also calls China's AI-driven stock rally that has boosted companies like Alibaba, Tencent and Baidu a "paper-tiger market."

content.title: Baidu shares stretched post rally despite AI cloud optimism
content.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley says the Baidu Inc’s valuation looks stretched after a recent rally, while the brokerage maintained its Equal-Weight rating and raising its price target. Analysts lifted their discounted cash flow-based target to $140 and introduced a sum-of-the-parts valuation of $220, on AI cloud and proprietary AI chips.
